name: spryker-community/search-debug
description: Search relevance debugging for Spryker storefronts: per-product Elasticsearch score/token overlay on the search results page, and a token-source page that attributes matched tokens back to the raw product fields they were indexed from.

suggest.spryker/merchant-storage: Marketplace shops only: adds merchant-name attribution to the token-source page. Without it every other token source still resolves; merchant names are simply omitted.

scripts-descriptions.check-floors: Verifies the declared dependency floors are real: resolves every constraint to its oldest allowed version (production deps only) and asserts each vendor symbol used in src/ actually exists there.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/, tests/, and tools/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 8. Must be run from a host shop (see README) — needs the shop's generated Generated\Shared\Transfer\* classes and a freshly regenerated Ide/AutoCompletion stub, neither of which this package can produce standalone.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-ci: Standalone CI variant of the phpstan check: generates just the Transfer and PageIndexMap classes this package needs (same generators the Portable test suite uses) and ignores the two categories of class that only exist inside a real host shop (Propel Orm\Zed\* models, the aggregated Ide\AutoCompletion stub) — see phpstan.ci.neon for exactly what's excluded and why.
